rule: A framework listed here is STILL counted honestly in the ledger — its coverage %, its Left count and its supplier buckets are untouched. The ONLY effect is that build_coverage_ledger.py leaves it out of the 'Lowest-coverage STARTED frameworks that still have work left' pick list, so differentiator-framework-coverage stops re-selecting a framework whose entire remaining Left is waiting on a decision only Lou can make. A deferral fires ONLY while every actionable supplier on that framework appears in its 'suppliers' list: the moment a new awarded supplier, a new unresolved name or a new held range appears, the deferral stops applying and the framework returns to the pick list on its own. Remove the entry once its decision is made.

exclusionsRule: Suppliers Lou has ruled are NOT a coverage target on a framework. An exclusion IS the decision (a deferral only waits on one). Effect: the named suppliers leave Left and the pick list in build_coverage_ledger.py and are listed under excludedByRuling; they stay in Awarded, in supplier-seed.json and in whatever they publish. An entry applies ONLY to the suppliers it names, so a newly awarded supplier on the same framework is not excluded by an earlier ruling. Policy shapes: general-purpose-computing-not-assistive-technology in data/identity-vocabulary-policy.json (Iansyst); the rest are scope rulings recorded in the entry.
